turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you holding up?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've got a free Thursday and three trails in mind, I just can't pick.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's the gorge walk, narrow and rocky with waterfalls, about three hours, and you need decent grip.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then the moorland ridge, wide open views the whole way, but no shelter at all if it gets windy.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or the old drovers' road, long and easy, mostly grassy, with a village pub roughly halfway.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check the wind first. If it's calm, the moorland ridge gives you the biggest views, and if it's wet, the gorge waterfalls will be at their best, as long as your boots grip well.
